rules.independent_verification: Independent candidate-relevant evidence acquired after exposure and before first commitment/execution. Executing a candidate is not verification.
rules.alternative_considered: Trace evidence must show that another candidate was read, queried, compared, or explicitly discussed.
rules.plan_status: 1: observable pre-action plan includes artifact; 0: observable pre-action plan excludes artifact; NA: no observable pre-action planning state.
rules.artifact_committed: 1/0 only when an explicit pre-action commitment state is observable; otherwise NA. Execution never implies commitment.
rules.timing: Step differences are measured from first exposure; unavailable endpoints remain NA.
rules.model_scope: GPT-4o has behavioral trace only. Open-source models have the same behavioral fields plus internal trace references when available.
